planner_fields.target_scope: Shop storefront: browse catalog, add to cart, and checkout flow
planner_fields.intent: Verify a logged-in shopper can find a product and complete a purchase end to end
planner_fields.expected_behavior: Cart totals reflect item prices and quantities, and a successful checkout returns an order confirmation with an order id
planner_fields.priority_risk: Payment submission, inventory decrement, and cart total arithmetic are the highest-risk areas
planner_fields.test_data_preconditions: Seeded product catalog with at least one in-stock item and a registered user resolvable via the Basic-Auth credential reference
planner_fields.out_of_scope_constraints: No real payment gateway is exercised; do not mutate other users' data or the seeded admin account
